A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same theoretical study of TD, FQI, and PFQI. Their 60 pages, including Sections 1–11 and Appendices A–H, are readable and support matching the relocated material and mathematical edits.

before.justification: v1 reports convergence theory and algebraic counterexamples. Appendix G.3 uses specified matrices and eigenvalues to demonstrate theoretical conclusions; no original experiments, simulations, user studies, or empirical data analyses are reported.

after.justification: v2 retains the theoretical proofs and algebraic counterexamples, including Appendix G.3. Inspection of the main text and appendices establishes no original experimental, simulation, user-study, or empirical data-analysis outcomes.

M1.justification: The TD, FQI, and PFQI update procedures, preconditioners, and minimum-norm FQI solution choice are retained. The formula corrections concern supporting mathematics rather than changes to the algorithms.

E1.justification: Neither version uses empirical datasets or evaluation tasks. The theoretical on-policy, off-policy, batch, stochastic, and feature-rank settings remain unchanged.

E2.justification: The same algorithms participate in the theoretical comparisons and Appendix G.3 counterexamples. Neither version contains empirical baseline evaluations.

E3.justification: No performed evaluation protocol is introduced or revised. The population and batch formulations are retained; restoring the learning-rate factor in Appendix B.1 corrects mathematics, not an experimental setting.

E4.justification: The feature-rank analyses and Appendix G.3 convergence counterexamples are retained. No ablation, robustness experiment, sensitivity study, or additional case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or comparable statistical uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: Appendix G.3 retains the same matrices, eigenvalues, reported values 1.011068 and 0.94628, and opposing TD/FQI convergence conclusions. No numerical result entries or empirical findings are added or removed.

T1.justification: Appendix B.1 corrects the invertibility lemma from sums of (I−A)^i to sums of (I−αA)^i (v1 Lemma 11; v2 Lemma 12). Section 7 corrects A_FQI to A_LSTD in the TD fixed-point description. The retained pseudoinverse lemma also gains an explicit transpose step. The rank-invariance equivalence is relocated, not newly established.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and Discussion retain the same unifying framework, convergence characterizations without feature-independence assumptions, and claims about connections among TD, FQI, and PFQI.

C2.justification: The encoder-decoder interpretation and applicability qualifications remain unchanged. The explanation that rank invariance is a mild condition moves from v1 Appendix D.3.3 to v2 Section 5.1.1 without changing its meaning.

D1.justification: The algorithm specifications and generic batch-data definitions are retained. No implementation settings, hardware information, training costs, or code/data access information are added or revised.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix H, and the reference list retain the same works and research positioning. The additional pinpoint citation to the already-cited Meyer textbook supports a proof detail without changing the relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: v2 moves the rank-invariance explanation and lemma into Section 5.1.1 and their supporting proofs into Appendix C.1.2. It also makes limited prose and cross-reference corrections and expands the Appendix G heading. The overall narrative remains intact.

P2.justification: Relocated mathematical material changes the placement of displayed lemmas, equations, and surrounding page breaks. Both versions retain the same single-column design, with no figures or tables added or removed.

improvement.justification: Restoring α in Appendix B.1 and correcting the TD fixed-point matrix improve mathematical consistency. The expanded pseudoinverse proof and earlier placement of the rank-invariance explanation make the argument easier to follow and verify. These are useful local improvements within an otherwise retained theoretical contribution.
